trees.in<-list.files(tree.fold,pattern = ".treefile",full.names = T) %>%

l.tr<-length(trees.in)

#genin clades (per-sequence, already merged with metadata)

## Read in the trees, meta, and genin data
```{r}
meta<-trees<-replicate(n=l.tr, vector())
for(i in 1:l.tr){
  trees[[i]]<-ape::read.tree(trees.in[i])
  meta[[i]]<-read.csv(meta.in[i])
}

## read in the genin clades
genin<-read.csv(genin.in)
genin<-genin %>% select(-any_of(c("...1","X")))

# "[unassigned]" → NA in whole-genome genotype
genin$genin_geno[genin$genin_geno == "[unassigned]"] <- NA

## placeholder of genin_HA that is the same for all: all cells are h5
genin$genin_HA<-"h5"

# "?" → NA in per-segment clade columns
genin_seg_cols<-c("genin_PB2","genin_PB1","genin_PA","genin_HA",
                  "genin_NP","genin_NA","genin_M","genin_NS")

for(col in genin_seg_cols){
  if(col %in% colnames(genin)) genin[[col]][genin[[col]] == "?"] <- NA
}

# flag subgeno presence (only applies to EA-2024-DI); concatenate to genotype where present
genin <- genin %>%
  mutate(
    has_subgeno = !is.na(genin_subgeno) & genin_subgeno != "",
    genin_genotype = case_when(
      has_subgeno ~ paste(genin_geno, genin_subgeno, sep="_"),
      TRUE        ~ genin_geno
    )
  )

# genin is HA-only; add sample_meta = the meta-format sample ID (underscore separator)
# so we can join genin to any segment's meta[[i]] by sample
ha_lookup <- read.csv(paste0(meta.fold, "trim_nodup_nuc_HA_rooted_resid.csv")) %>%
  select(seq_new, sample_meta=sample) %>%
  distinct(seq_new, .keep_all=TRUE)
genin <- genin %>% left_join(ha_lookup, by="seq_new")
cat("genin rows with matched sample_meta:", sum(!is.na(genin$sample_meta)), "of", nrow(genin), "\n")
```


## Connect genin data to per-segment metadata
```{r}
# map segment name to its genin clade column
seg_to_genin_col<-c("PB2"="genin_PB2","PB1"="genin_PB1",
                    "PA"="genin_PA","HA"="genin_HA",
                    "NP"="genin_NP", "NA"="genin_NA",
                    "M"="genin_M","NS"="genin_NS")

for (i in 1:l.tr){
  myseg<-as.character(meta[[i]]$segment[1])
  if(is.na(myseg)){myseg<-"NA"}
  # join by sample_meta: meta-format sample ID added to genin via HA lookup
  # (genin$sample uses dash; meta$sample uses underscore — sample_meta bridges the gap)
  join_cols<-c("sample_meta","genin_genotype","has_subgeno")
  if(myseg %in% names(seg_to_genin_col)){
    seg_col<-unname(seg_to_genin_col[myseg])
    tempdf<-genin %>%
      filter(!is.na(sample_meta)) %>%
      select(all_of(c(join_cols, seg_col))) %>%
      distinct(sample_meta, .keep_all=TRUE)
    names(tempdf)[names(tempdf) == seg_col] <- "genin_cluster"
  } else {
    tempdf<-genin %>%
      filter(!is.na(sample_meta)) %>%
      select(all_of(join_cols)) %>%
      distinct(sample_meta, .keep_all=TRUE) %>%
      mutate(genin_cluster=NA_character_)
  }
  meta[[i]]<-meta[[i]] %>% select(-any_of(c("genin_genotype","has_subgeno","genin_cluster")))
  cat(myseg, ": tempdf has", nrow(tempdf), "samples;",
      length(which(meta[[i]]$sample %in% tempdf$sample_meta)), "of", nrow(meta[[i]]), "meta samples matched\n")
  meta[[i]]<-left_join(meta[[i]], tempdf, by=c("sample"="sample_meta"))
}

## check all tree's tipnames match meta
for (i in 1:l.tr){
  print(all(trees[[i]]$tip.label %in% meta[[i]]$seq_new))
}
```

## Compare distrib of within and between cluster pat dists
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ape);library(dplyr);library(ggplot2)})

set.seed(111)
sample_frac<-0.25              # fraction of all possible comparisons to sample
max_samples_per_type<-5e6      # hard cap to avoid excessive memory use

choose2<-function(n)n*(n-1)/2  # helper: number of pairwise combinations

# sample within-cluster distances without materializing all pairs
sample_within_distances<-function(D,cluster_indices,n_draw){
  sizes<-vapply(cluster_indices,length,integer(1))
  pair_counts<-choose2(sizes)
  keep<-which(pair_counts>0)
  if(length(keep)==0||n_draw<=0)return(numeric(0))
  pair_counts<-pair_counts[keep]
  clusters_keep<-cluster_indices[keep]
  # sample clusters proportional to number of within-cluster pairs
  pick<-sample.int(length(clusters_keep),size=n_draw,replace=TRUE,prob=pair_counts)
  out<-numeric(n_draw)
  for(j in seq_len(n_draw)){
    idx<-clusters_keep[[pick[j]]]
    ab<-sample(idx,size=2,replace=FALSE)  # sample two distinct tips
    out[j]<-D[ab[1],ab[2]]
  }
  out
}

# sample between-cluster distances without building full cross blocks
sample_between_distances<-function(D,cluster_indices,n_draw){
  sizes<-vapply(cluster_indices,length,integer(1))
  k<-length(cluster_indices)
  if(k<2||n_draw<=0)return(numeric(0))
  pairs_i<-integer(0);pairs_j<-integer(0);weights<-numeric(0)
  # enumerate cluster pairs and weight by nk*nl
  for(a in 1:(k-1)){
    na<-sizes[a]
    if(na==0)next
    for(b in (a+1):k){
      nb<-sizes[b]
      if(nb==0)next
      w<-na*nb
      if(w>0){
        pairs_i<-c(pairs_i,a)
        pairs_j<-c(pairs_j,b)
        weights<-c(weights,w)
      }
    }
  }
  if(length(weights)==0)return(numeric(0))
  # sample cluster-pairs proportional to number of cross pairs
  pick<-sample.int(length(weights),size=n_draw,replace=TRUE,prob=weights)
  out<-numeric(n_draw)
  for(j in seq_len(n_draw)){
    a<-pairs_i[pick[j]];b<-pairs_j[pick[j]]
    ia<-sample(cluster_indices[[a]],size=1)
    ib<-sample(cluster_indices[[b]],size=1)
    out[j]<-D[ia,ib]
  }
  out
}

for(i in seq_along(trees)){
  segment<-segments.ms[i]
  cat("Processing segment:",segment,"\n")

  # filter to tips with a named genin_cluster (exclude NA and "Unassigned")
  cluster_df<-meta[[i]] %>%
    select(seq_new,genin_cluster) %>%
    filter(!is.na(genin_cluster), genin_cluster != "Unassigned")
  assigned_tips<-intersect(trees[[i]]$tip.label, cluster_df$seq_new)
  if(length(assigned_tips)<2){
    cat("  Skipping",segment,": fewer than 2 assigned tips\n"); next
  }
  subtree<-keep.tip(trees[[i]], assigned_tips)

  # compute full cophenetic matrix on assigned subtree (main memory cost)
  D<-cophenetic.phylo(subtree)

  # align cluster assignments to subtree tip order
  cluster_vec<-cluster_df$genin_cluster[match(rownames(D), cluster_df$seq_new)]

  # split tip indices by cluster
  cluster_indices<-split(seq_along(cluster_vec),cluster_vec)
  sizes<-vapply(cluster_indices,length,integer(1))

  # compute total possible within and between comparisons
  n_within_pairs<-sum(choose2(sizes))
  n_total<-sum(sizes)
  n_between_pairs<-(n_total^2-sum(sizes^2))/2

  # determine how many distances to sample for plotting
  n_within_draw<-min(max_samples_per_type,ceiling(sample_frac*n_within_pairs))
  n_between_draw<-min(max_samples_per_type,ceiling(sample_frac*n_between_pairs))

  # sample distances directly from D
  within_vals<-sample_within_distances(D,cluster_indices,n_within_draw)
  between_vals<-sample_between_distances(D,cluster_indices,n_between_draw)

  # minimal dataframe for density plotting
  plot_df<-data.frame(value=c(within_vals,between_vals),type=c(rep("within",length(within_vals)),rep("between",length(between_vals))))

  p<-ggplot(plot_df)+
    geom_density(aes(x=value,fill=type),alpha=0.5,adjust=2)+
    plot.theme+
    labs(x="Patristic distance within or between clusters")+
    ggtitle(segment)+
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("darkred","darkblue"))

  ggsave(filename=paste0(f.out,segment,"_patdist_withinbetween.tiff"),plot=p,height=5,width=6)

  # clean up large objects before next segment
  rm(D,subtree,within_vals,between_vals,plot_df,p,cluster_vec,cluster_indices);gc()
}
```

## Quantify monophyly for genin genotypes
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ape);library(dplyr);library(tidyr);library(ggplot2)})

set.seed(111)

if(exists("segments.ms"))segments<-segments.ms
segments_positional<-sort(segments)

out_dir<-"cluster_eval"
if(exists("f.out"))out_dir<-f.out
if(!dir.exists(out_dir))dir.create(out_dir,recursive=TRUE)

# fast precompute for rooted binary trees:
# - parent of each node
# - children list per internal node
# - postorder internal nodes (parent after children)
# - descendant tip counts per node
precompute_tree_cache<-function(tree){
  if(!is.rooted(tree))tree<-root(tree,outgroup=tree$tip.label[1],resolve.root=TRUE)
  tree<-reorder.phylo(tree,order="postorder")
  n_tip<-length(tree$tip.label)
  n_all<-n_tip+tree$Nnode
  parent<-integer(n_all)
  parent[tree$edge[,2]]<-tree$edge[,1]
  children<-split(tree$edge[,2],tree$edge[,1])
  post_nodes<-tree$edge[,1]
  post_nodes<-post_nodes[!duplicated(post_nodes)]
  desc_tip_n<-integer(n_all)
  desc_tip_n[seq_len(n_tip)]<-1L
  for(v in post_nodes){
    ch<-children[[as.character(v)]]
    if(length(ch)==0)next
    desc_tip_n[v]<-sum(desc_tip_n[ch])
  }
  edge_len<-numeric(n_all)
  edge_len[tree$edge[,2]]<-tree$edge.length
  list(tree=tree,n_tip=n_tip,n_all=n_all,parent=parent,children=children,post_nodes=post_nodes,desc_tip_n=desc_tip_n,node_depth=node.depth.edgelength(tree),edge_len=edge_len)
}

# Fitch parsimony score for a binary tip character (0/1), unordered, returns minimum # changes
# tree cache must be postorder; children map reused across clusters
fitch_parsimony_binary_cache<-function(cache,x){
  n_all<-cache$n_all
  children<-cache$children
  post_nodes<-cache$post_nodes
  n_tip<-cache$n_tip
  S0<-logical(n_all);S1<-logical(n_all)
  tip_idx<-seq_len(n_tip)
  S0[tip_idx]<-x==0
  S1[tip_idx]<-x==1
  score<-0L
  for(v in post_nodes){
    ch<-children[[as.character(v)]]
    if(length(ch)==0)next
    i1<-ch[1];i2<-ch[2]
    a0<-S0[i1]&&S0[i2];a1<-S1[i1]&&S1[i2]
    if(a0||a1){
      S0[v]<-a0;S1[v]<-a1
    } else {
      S0[v]<-(S0[i1]||S0[i2]);S1[v]<-(S1[i1]||S1[i2])
      score<-score+1L
    }
  }
  score
}

evaluate_segment_clusters_fast<-function(tree,cluster_df,seg_id,method_id,cluster_col="genin_cluster",do_fragmentation=FALSE){
  # exclude NA and "Unassigned" — only evaluate named clade labels
  cluster_df<-cluster_df[!is.na(cluster_df[[cluster_col]]) &
                           cluster_df[[cluster_col]] != "Unassigned",,drop=FALSE]
  # prune tree to assigned tips only
  n_orig<-Ntip(tree)
  keep<-intersect(tree$tip.label,cluster_df$seq_new)
  if(length(keep)<2){
    warning("  ",seg_id,": fewer than 2 assigned tips — skipping")
    return(list(cluster_table=data.frame(),segment_table=data.frame()))
  }
  if(length(keep)<n_orig){
    tree<-keep.tip(tree,keep)
    cat("  ",seg_id,": pruned to",length(keep),"of",n_orig,"tips\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ",seg_id,": all",n_orig,"tips assigned\n")
  }

  # tree cache computed once per segment
  cache<-precompute_tree_cache(tree)
  tree<-cache$tree
  n_tip<-cache$n_tip
  parent<-cache$parent
  node_depth<-cache$node_depth
  desc_tip_n<-cache$desc_tip_n
  edge_len<-cache$edge_len

  # align cluster assignments to tree tip order
  tip_pos<-match(cluster_df$seq_new,tree$tip.label)
  cluster_df<-cluster_df[!is.na(tip_pos),,drop=FALSE]
  cluster_df$tip_idx<-match(cluster_df$seq_new,tree$tip.label)
  cluster_vec<-rep(NA_character_,n_tip)
  cluster_vec[cluster_df$tip_idx]<-as.character(cluster_df[[cluster_col]])
  if(anyNA(cluster_vec)){
    # second-pass prune: some tree tips had no cluster_df match; drop and continue
    n_missing<-sum(is.na(cluster_vec))
    warning("  ",seg_id,": ",n_missing,"/",n_tip," tips had no cluster match — pruning and continuing")
    assigned_labels<-tree$tip.label[!is.na(cluster_vec)]
    tree<-keep.tip(tree,assigned_labels)
    cache<-precompute_tree_cache(tree)
    tree<-cache$tree;n_tip<-cache$n_tip;parent<-cache$parent
    node_depth<-cache$node_depth;desc_tip_n<-cache$desc_tip_n;edge_len<-cache$edge_len
    cluster_df<-cluster_df[!is.na(match(cluster_df$seq_new,tree$tip.label)),,drop=FALSE]
    cluster_df$tip_idx<-match(cluster_df$seq_new,tree$tip.label)
    cluster_vec<-rep(NA_character_,n_tip)
    cluster_vec[cluster_df$tip_idx]<-as.character(cluster_df[[cluster_col]])
    if(anyNA(cluster_vec))stop("Cannot resolve cluster assignments for segment=",seg_id)
  }

  clusters<-sort(unique(cluster_vec))
  cluster_indices<-split(seq_len(n_tip),cluster_vec)

  # preallocate per-cluster outputs
  k<-length(clusters)
  cl_nodes<-integer(k)
  cl_sizes<-integer(k)
  cl_purity<-numeric(k)
  cl_type<-character(k)
  cl_frag<-integer(k)
  cl_mrca_depth<-numeric(k)
  cl_mrca_desc_n<-integer(k)
  cl_pd<-numeric(k)

  # Faith's PD: total branch length of the minimal subtree connecting a cluster's
  # tips to their MRCA. Paths are walked tip->MRCA and each edge counted once via
  # a per-cluster stamp (avoids double-counting where paths converge).
  pd_stamp<-integer(cache$n_all)

  for(ci in seq_len(k)){
    cl<-clusters[ci]
    tips_idx<-cluster_indices[[cl]]
    tips_lab<-tree$tip.label[tips_idx]
    cl_sizes[ci]<-length(tips_idx)

    # MRCA and descendant tip count used for purity; no descendant-tip enumeration
    if(length(tips_idx)==1){
      mrca<-tips_idx
      cl_nodes[ci]<-mrca
      cl_mrca_depth[ci]<-node_depth[mrca]
      cl_mrca_desc_n[ci]<-1L
      cl_purity[ci]<-1
      cl_type[ci]<-"singleton"
      cl_frag[ci]<-0L
      cl_pd[ci]<-0
      next
    }

    mrca<-getMRCA(tree,tips_lab)
    cl_nodes[ci]<-mrca
    cl_mrca_depth[ci]<-node_depth[mrca]
    cl_mrca_desc_n[ci]<-desc_tip_n[mrca]
    cl_purity[ci]<-length(tips_idx)/desc_tip_n[mrca]

    pd<-0
    for(ti in tips_idx){
      node<-ti
      while(node!=mrca&&pd_stamp[node]!=ci){
        pd_stamp[node]<-ci
        pd<-pd+edge_len[node]
        node<-parent[node]
      }
    }
    cl_pd[ci]<-pd

    # fragmentation score computed only if requested
    frag<-NA_integer_
    if(isTRUE(do_fragmentation)){
      x<-rep(0L,n_tip);x[tips_idx]<-1L
      frag<-fitch_parsimony_binary_cache(cache,x)
    } else {
      frag<-NA_integer_
    }
    cl_frag[ci]<-ifelse(is.na(frag),NA_integer_,frag)

    # monophyly/paraphyly/polyphyly classification:
    # monophyletic: purity==1
    # polyphyletic: fragmentation>=2 (membership arises in multiple disjoint regions)
    # paraphyletic: otherwise
    if(cl_purity[ci]==1){
      cl_type[ci]<-"monophyletic"
    } else if(!is.na(frag)&&frag>=2){
      cl_type[ci]<-"polyphyletic"
    } else {
      cl_type[ci]<-"paraphyletic"
    }
  }

  # nested detection using parent-walk with node->cluster map (avoids cluster x cluster matching)
  node_to_cluster<-integer(cache$n_all)
  for(ci in seq_len(k)){
    n<-cl_nodes[ci]
    if(node_to_cluster[n]==0L)node_to_cluster[n]<-ci
  }
  nested_in<-rep(NA_character_,k)
  nested_out_n<-integer(k)
  for(ci in seq_len(k)){
    cur<-parent[cl_nodes[ci]]
    while(cur>0&&node_to_cluster[cur]==0L)cur<-parent[cur]
    if(cur>0&&node_to_cluster[cur]>0L){
      nested_in[ci]<-clusters[node_to_cluster[cur]]
      nested_out_n[node_to_cluster[cur]]<-nested_out_n[node_to_cluster[cur]]+1L
    }
  }

  cl_tbl<-data.frame(segment=seg_id,method=method_id,cluster=clusters,n_tips=as.integer(cl_sizes),type=cl_type,mrca_node=as.integer(cl_nodes),mrca_depth=as.numeric(cl_mrca_depth),mrca_desc_n=as.integer(cl_mrca_desc_n),purity=as.numeric(cl_purity),fragmentation=as.integer(cl_frag),nested_in=as.character(nested_in),nested_out_n=as.integer(nested_out_n),faith_pd=as.numeric(cl_pd),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

  seg_tbl<-cl_tbl%>%summarise(segment=seg_id,method=method_id,n_clusters=n(),n_tips_total=sum(n_tips),prop_clusters_monophyletic=mean(type=="monophyletic"),prop_tips_monophyletic=sum(n_tips[type=="monophyletic"])/sum(n_tips),prop_clusters_paraphyletic=mean(type=="paraphyletic"),prop_clusters_polyphyletic=mean(type=="polyphyletic"),mean_purity=mean(purity[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),median_purity=median(purity[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),mean_fragmentation=mean(fragmentation,na.rm=TRUE),median_fragmentation=median(fragmentation,na.rm=TRUE),mean_mrca_depth=mean(mrca_depth[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),median_mrca_depth=median(mrca_depth[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),prop_clusters_nested_in=mean(!is.na(nested_in)),mean_faith_pd=mean(faith_pd[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),median_faith_pd=median(faith_pd[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),mean_faith_pd_per_tip=mean((faith_pd/n_tips)[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),median_faith_pd_per_tip=median((faith_pd/n_tips)[n_tips>1],na.rm=TRUE),.groups="drop")

  list(cluster_table=cl_tbl,segment_table=seg_tbl)
}

# inputs expected:
# trees: list of phylo objects across segments in positional alphabetical order
# meta: list of data.frames across segments, each containing seq_new and genin_cluster
if(!exists("trees"))stop("Object 'trees' not found")
if(!exists("meta"))stop("Object 'meta' not found")
if(length(trees)!=length(segments_positional))stop("Length mismatch: trees=",length(trees),", segments=",length(segments_positional))
if(length(meta)!=length(segments_positional))stop("Length mismatch: meta=",length(meta),", segments=",length(segments_positional))

# set do_fragmentation=FALSE for a large speedup if fragmentation is not required for a given run
do_fragmentation<-FALSE

# QC: Unassigned counts per segment
cat("=== genin_cluster Unassigned counts ===\n")
for(i in seq_along(segments_positional)){
  seg<-segments_positional[i]
  n<-nrow(meta[[i]])
  cat(seg,": Unassigned =",sum(meta[[i]]$genin_cluster=="Unassigned",na.rm=TRUE),
      "| NA =",sum(is.na(meta[[i]]$genin_cluster)),"/",n,"\n")
}
cat("=======================================\n")

cl_all<-list();seg_all<-list()
for(i in seq_along(segments_positional)){
  seg<-segments_positional[i]
  cat("Processing segment:",seg,"\n")
  res<-evaluate_segment_clusters_fast(trees[[i]],meta[[i]],seg,"genin_cluster",
                                      cluster_col="genin_cluster",
                                      do_fragmentation=do_fragmentation)
  cl_all[[seg]]<-res$cluster_table
  seg_all[[seg]]<-res$segment_table
}

cluster_metrics_all<-bind_rows(cl_all)
segment_metrics_all<-bind_rows(seg_all)

write.csv(cluster_metrics_all,file=paste0(out_dir,"/genin_cluster-metrics_all-segments.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(segment_metrics_all,file=paste0(out_dir,"/genin_segment-metrics_all-segments.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

plot_long_all<-cluster_metrics_all%>%
  mutate(type=factor(type,levels=c("monophyletic","paraphyletic","polyphyletic","singleton")))%>%
  select(segment,type,n_tips,purity,fragmentation,mrca_depth)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c(purity,fragmentation,mrca_depth,n_tips),names_to="metric",values_to="value")

p_all<-ggplot(plot_long_all,aes(x=value,y=log(..count..)))+
  geom_histogram(bins=60)+
  facet_grid(metric~segment,scales="free")+
  plot.theme+
  labs(x=NULL,y="count")
ggsave(filename=paste0(out_dir,"/genin_cluster_all-segments_cluster-metrics_hist.tiff"),plot=p_all,height=10,width=12)

plot_seg_long<-segment_metrics_all%>%
  select(segment,prop_clusters_monophyletic,prop_tips_monophyletic,mean_purity,mean_mrca_depth,prop_clusters_nested_in)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=-segment,names_to="metric",values_to="value")

p_seg<-ggplot(plot_seg_long,aes(x=segment,y=value))+
  geom_col()+
  facet_grid(metric~.,scales="free_y",switch="y")+
  plot.theme+
  labs(x=NULL,y=NULL)
ggsave(filename=paste0(out_dir,"/genin_cluster_all-segments_segment-summaries.tiff"),plot=p_seg,height=12,width=9)
```
